question: Which current integrated ensure_worker operations occupy the interval from model-tool ensure entry to prepared Membership publication, before terminal actuation?

external_anchor.status: comparison anchor only; this experiment does not reproduce its ambient workload

proof: The bridge subclass stops at launchPreparedMembership before its spawn callback.
Each successful trace verifies one current prepared Membership and one matching prepared event.
Each successful trace verifies zero spawn and zero task-reconciliation calls before the stop boundary.

conditions.name: isolated
conditions.definition: One ensure in one fresh child process with a fresh temporary home, Pi agent directory, project, Team, and event journal.

conditions.name: loaded
conditions.definition: Four concurrent ensures for distinct logical Workers in one fresh isolated Team; every request stops at the same pre-actuation boundary.

conditions.name: directory_loaded
conditions.definition: One ensure in a fresh isolated home that also contains 32 unrelated valid Team records. It measures exact leader-binding scan sensitivity without reading an ambient Team directory.

model_resolution.path: A temporary Worker default_model uses WorkerLaunchBridge.resolveNewWorkerModel and its resolveSettingsModel dependency.
model_resolution.limit: The integrated lanes validate a prepared qualified model locally. Sample the current pi --list-models helper separately with only its candidate identity redacted because its model catalog depends on the active profile and project.

task_reconciliation.reason: Current DurableModelToolTeamApplication calls reconcileReady only after WorkerLaunchBridge.ensureWorker resolves, while this experiment stops inside that bridge before actuation.

predictions: A clean isolated source-coupled pre-actuation path will be materially shorter than the reported 5.012 s canary span.
The dominant measured serial writes will be logical Worker and Membership configuration persistence plus prepared-event publication, not task reconciliation.
Loaded samples will show lock-sensitive tail growth in configuration persistence.
The controlled Team-directory condition will increase leader-binding scan time, but it cannot identify the ambient canary's directory cardinality.
The current-profile model catalog resolver may be a material serial cost when a Worker default_model needs validation.
